rules: Stable population_slot_ref/character identity survives all LOD changes.
Promotion preserves every established fact/history reference.
Detail reduction preserves identity/history and cannot anonymize a known individual.
Player proximity alone is not a promotion cause.
Direct interaction, close relationship, mentorship, recurring shared activity and consequential history may increase relevance.
Low LOD may aggregate routine contact.
Low LOD cannot fabricate friendship, romance, breakup, discipline, injury, qualification or career transition.
Major/consequential events remain explicit regardless of LOD.
Materialization consumes/preserves the same persistent population slot rather than creating a new person.
